name: Major Artistic Talent
body:
Prerequisites: Artistic Talent, 11 Charisma.

Benefit: A rogue with this talent selects one spell from the 1st level Bard spell list. She may use this spell two times per day as a spell-like ability, using her rogue level as her caster level. The DC for this spell is equal to 11 + the rogue’s Charisma modifier.
